findings.highlight: as if the horror of last night never happened
findings.evidenceJa: 昨夜の悪寒が嘘のように
findings.governingReading: 悪寒 is the prior physical chill contrasted with his present bodily recovery.
findings.explanation: Last night’s bodily chills become its horror.

findings.highlight: if I can't remember anything that happened.
findings.evidenceJa: 前後不覚になるなんて
findings.governingReading: 前後不覚 describes losing awareness/composure; the next row expressly says he remembers Saber supporting him and putting him to bed.
findings.explanation: Loss of awareness becomes inability to remember anything.

findings.governingReading: 朝メシの時にしよう carries forward the preceding plan to thank Saber: do it at breakfast because she is probably asleep now.
findings.explanation: Deferring thanks until breakfast becomes going to have breakfast.

findings.evidenceJa: テーブルも綺麗に拭かれている
findings.governingReading: 綺麗に拭かれている specifies wiping as part of Sakura’s completed preparation.
findings.explanation: A table wiped clean becomes a neatly arranged table.

findings.highlight: the thought gives me so much nausea that I can't remember.
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気が酷くてよく覚えていない
findings.governingReading: 吐き気が酷くてよく覚えていない explains indistinct recollection through the earlier physical illness; he has just stated he feels well now.
findings.explanation: Severe nausea at the time impaired memory becomes thinking about it now causing nausea.

findings.highlight: I remember talking with you and Saber about something.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜とセイバーがなんか話してた気がする。……よく聞こえなかったんだけど、そん時なにかあったのか？
findings.governingReading: Sakura and Saber were talking; Shirou thinks he heard them unclearly and asks what happened.
findings.explanation: Vaguely overhearing Sakura and Saber becomes remembering participating in their talk.

findings.evidenceJa: わたし、セイバーさんに
findings.governingReading: わたし、セイバーさんに resumes Sakura’s guilt over her own words directed at Saber.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.
